Title: Login with valid credentials
Preconditions: Account with required access is available
Test Steps: Open https://dev.master.bwrfm.com/en/rfid_generator/?act=view; enter email and password; click Sign in
Expected Result: User is signed in; left sidebar (Generator, Recent Generated, RFID List, Style Number List, Mother List, Transaction List, Others) is visible; no error shown
Remarks: Baseline for all modules

Title: Login with invalid password
Test Steps: Open login page; enter valid email with a wrong password; click Sign in
Expected Result: Login fails with a clear invalid-credentials message; no session created; protected pages are not reachable

Title: Sign in with empty fields
Test Steps: Leave email and password blank; click Sign in
Expected Result: Client-side validation message shown; no authentication request sent; user stays on login

Title: Login with malformed email
Test Steps: Enter 'notanemail' as email; click Sign in
Expected Result: Invalid email format validation shown; login not attempted

Title: Non-admin cannot access admin-only actions
Preconditions: Signed in as a non-admin user
Test Steps: Open RFID List and All Users; check for Delete Selected, RFM Admin toggle and Create User
Expected Result: Admin-only controls are hidden or disabled; direct admin URLs do not grant access
Remarks: Doc: non-admin users do not have deletion access

Title: Generate a series with a single item code
Preconditions: Signed in; valid item code 5057877230509 available
Test Steps: Open Generator; Item Code tab; enter 1 item code; Starting Serial 0; Quantity 16; click Generate Series
Expected Result: Generation Summary opens showing proposed row count and item-code count plus Style Number, Style Name, Color, Mother, Item Code, Size, Qty, Serial Range and EPC Range (Start and End)

Title: Continue from Generation Summary populates Generated Series
Test Steps: Review the summary; click Continue
Expected Result: Generated Series fills with the expected rows; columns Item Code, Style Number, Style Name, Color, Size, RFID, Serial and Copy are present; counters update
Remarks: Doc example: 16 rows, 1 style, 0 mother, 16 child

Title: Generate with multiple item codes on separate lines
Test Steps: Enter 4 item codes one per line; set Starting Serial and Quantity; click Generate Series; click Continue
Expected Result: All 4 codes appear in Item Code Status; rows generated for the codes; counters reflect the generated data
Remarks: Doc example tracks 4 codes

Title: Others tab inputs affect encoding
Test Steps: Open Others tab; confirm GS1 company prefix length 7, Filter = POS Trade Item (1), Serial Step 1; generate a series

Expected Result: Validation error identifies the invalid code; no summary or rows produced

Test Steps: Enter the same item code twice on separate lines; click Generate Series
Expected Result: Duplicates are de-duplicated or clearly flagged; no duplicate pending rows are created

Test Steps: Set Starting Serial 0 and Quantity 1; click Generate Series; click Continue
Expected Result: Serial 0 accepted; exactly one row generated with serial 0

Title: Negative Starting Serial rejected
Test Steps: Enter Starting Serial -1; click Generate Series
Expected Result: Rejected with 'whole number of 0 or greater' validation; nothing generated

Title: Decimal Starting Serial rejected
Test Steps: Enter Starting Serial 1.5; click Generate Series
Expected Result: Rejected: whole numbers only

Title: Quantity = 1 (minimum)
Test Steps: Set Quantity 1; click Generate Series; click Continue
Expected Result: Exactly one row generated

Test Steps: Set Quantity 5000; click Generate Series; click Continue
Expected Result: Accepted; 5000 rows generated (or per-item quantity applied) and all counters match

Title: Cancel Generation Summary

Expected Result: Behavior matches the confirmed documented expectation; no unintended data loss

Title: Search item code filter

Title: Pagination controls

Title: Save valid pending records

Test Steps: Click Save
Expected Result: Record not saved; clear validation result identifying the invalid row; pending rows retained

Title: Duplicate EPC within one request
Preconditions: Pending rows include a duplicate EPC
Test Steps: Click Save
Expected Result: Duplicate blocked; no duplicate records saved

Title: Save failure keeps pending rows
Test Steps: Trigger a failed save; observe the message; check pending rows
Expected Result: Error is displayed; pending rows remain available for review or retry; no records silently saved

Title: Retry after an unclear failure does not duplicate
Test Steps: Check whether records were saved in RFID List; retry generation/save only if needed
Expected Result: No conflicting or duplicate transaction is created; a single set of records exists

Title: EPC is exactly 24 hex characters
Test Steps: Generate a series; inspect the EPC values
Expected Result: All EPCs are exactly 24 characters using only 0-9 and A-F

Title: EPC with wrong length rejected
Test Steps: Attempt to save EPCs with 23 and 25 characters
Expected Result: Blocked with a clear validation result; records not saved

Title: 24-character non-hex EPC rejected
Test Steps: Save a 24-character value containing letters G-Z
Expected Result: Blocked; correct length alone is not sufficient

Test Steps: Save a 24-hex value that fails SGTIN-96 decoding
Expected Result: Blocked with a clear validation result

Title: Decoded GTIN does not match item GTIN
Test Steps: Save an EPC whose decoded GTIN differs from the generated/selected item GTIN

Title: Decoded serial does not match generated serial
Test Steps: Save an EPC whose decoded serial differs from the generated serial
Expected Result: Blocked and the mismatch is reported

Preconditions: Imported records store serial 0 but their valid EPCs decode to 9006 and 9020; a wrong-format record stores serial 9999
Test Steps: Generate the next series for the same item
Expected Result: Next generated serial is 9021; the wrong-format 9999 record is ignored in the calculation
Remarks: Documented continuation example

Title: Skips occupied and conflicting positions
Preconditions: 27DA taken, 27DB available, 27DC and 27DD conflict with another item

Expected Result: Next safe suffix generated is 27DE; no duplicate or conflicting EPC is produced
Remarks: Documented collision example - specific scenario, not a general gap-fill rule

Expected Result: Colliding values are skipped or the conflict is reported; no duplicate in RFID List
